ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-10-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Judge: Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/M. Vallejo, CSR: Lavon Granger.
Petitioner, Raymond K. Yi the Guardian ad litem for the minor, Constance Youngmin Yi present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
The Court grants the petition for change of the minor's name to: Connie Youngmin Yi.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
